product.name: Regology Regulatory Intelligence Platform
product.description: A platform that identifies applicable regulatory content, monitors changes, and generates compliance obligations, risks, controls, and policies.

product.name: Regulatory Change Management Module
product.description: Automates tracking and alerts for regulatory changes across jurisdictions to keep compliance teams informed.

product.name: Compliance Management Module
product.description: Organizes and manages compliance workflows, policies, risks, and controls with integration to GRC platforms.

product.name: Reggi Generative AI Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered assistant that answers natural language queries about regulatory requirements and compliance.

product.name: Smart Law Library
product.description: A customizable, continuously updated repository of applicable laws and regulations tailored to an organization's needs.

product.name: GRC Integration and Synchronization
product.description: API-driven integration that synchronizes regulatory data and compliance objects with existing Governance, Risk, and Compliance systems.
